words: Yes account A is close to the limit, so can you continue here?
asked: b.outreach, 18:19 UTC: who keeps sovereignwebsite.ai for the invite page, a keeper on account B or wait for website.a (quiet since 25 Nov 18:30 UTC)? Also: github-tool.a, the GitHub browser tool's keeper on account A, has gone quiet.
decision: Keepers on account B take over SovereignWebsite__Website (from website.a) and Site__Tool__GitHub (from github-tool.a), instead of account D as in cl-1.maestro's moves plan. maestro.b starts the two keepers.

how.handover: Each new keeper starts from the repository's own docs/keeper/restart.md and records the handover in it; the account A keeper, if it wakes, hands over rather than works in parallel.
how.unchanged: Write access goes only through the existing Org apply keeper settings for those repositories; nothing else widens. The CMS sign-in phase stays Dinis's decision with its own security review.
how.note: Account B was itself near its weekly limit from about 16:20 UTC (maestro.b).

applies_to: the two new account B keepers
